name: Rise | 3oz THC/CBD Topical | Recovery Cream
description:
RISE Recovery Cream is uniquely formulated to provide equal parts of THC, CBD, and THCA for additional inflammation control. This plant-based formulation helps provide relief from localized areas of discomfort while also moisturizing. Absorbing fast and deep into the skin, RISE Cream goes on easily and doesn’t leave behind any sticky or smelly residue.

Key Benefits

Localized pain relief

Reduces inflammation

Relief from muscle spasms

Arthritis discomfort relief

• Available in 3oz. (3000mg)

• 1000mg THC : 1000mg CBD : 1000mg THCA

• Squeeze tube delivery for easy application

• Paraben & Sulfate Free

• Quick Dry

• Unscented

• Plant-Based

• pH Balanced

• 2:1:1 Formulation

Apply generously on and around the affected area. Continue application as needed to achieve relief. Do not apply on or around eyes, broken skin, or open wounds. For external use only, discontinue if irritation occurs.
